title: Instructions hidden in user input
summary: A user types text that tells the assistant to ignore its rules.

title: Instructions hidden in retrieved documents
summary: A document the assistant reads carries instructions meant for it.

title: Prompt manipulation across input and documents
summary: Instructions arrive both from the user and from retrieved text.

title: Tool call with altered arguments
summary: The arguments of a tool call are changed on the way to the tool.

title: Agent chains tools past its brief
summary: Calls that are each allowed combine into an outcome nobody allowed.

title: Answer states what the sources do not say
summary: A generated answer asserts something no source supports.

title: Figures in an answer do not match the record
summary: A number in generated text differs from the number in the record.

title: Narrative with unsupported claims or wrong figures
summary: A generated narrative mixes claims with no source and figures that are off.

title: Provider changes the model without notice
summary: Behaviour moves although nobody on the team changed anything.

title: Model upgrade changes behaviour and supplier terms
summary: A planned upgrade moves quality and the terms of supply together.

title: Input data moves away from the training data
summary: Production inputs stop resembling what the model was built on.

title: Quality decays and nobody can show when
summary: Quality falls over months and the record cannot date the fall.

title: Agent holds more permissions than it uses
summary: The grant is wider than the work, so a mistake has a wider reach.

title: Agent skips an approval step
summary: An action that needs a person's approval runs without it.

title: Agent exceeds scope and skips approval
summary: Both failures at once on the same action.

title: Outputs differ across customer groups
summary: The same request gets a worse result for one group.

title: Supplier alters a tool definition
summary: The description or schema of a supplied tool changes under the agent.

title: Supplier compromise reaches the agent
summary: A compromised supplier feeds the agent content and widens its reach.

title: Decisions cannot be reconstructed afterwards
summary: The record of a decision is too thin to replay it.

title: Record of an approved action is missing or altered
summary: The approval happened but the record of it cannot be trusted.

title: Hidden instructions steer tool choice
summary: Text in the input changes which tool the agent calls.

title: Answers cite a source that does not exist
summary: A citation points at a document that is not in the corpus.

title: Fairness gap appears after a model change
summary: A group gap opens when the model version moves.

title: Model endpoint is unavailable at peak
summary: The service cannot be reached when demand is highest.
